svg.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: CH3CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3 + oxidant → 2 CH3CHO + reduced Mn / water. Further oxidation cleaves the C–C bond; the oxidation network is grouped, not claimed as one known elementary transition structure.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Further oxidation cleaves the C–C bond; the oxidation network is grouped, not claimed as one known elementary transition structure.
